name: Fidras by CatalystIQ – Your Growth Partner
author: catalystiq

sections.description:
Fidras by CatalystIQ connects your WooCommerce store to the Fidras analytics platform, providing:

  • Customer Analytics – RFM segmentation, lifetime value, churn prediction
  • Order Analytics – Revenue trends, AOV tracking, fulfillment metrics
  • Product Analytics – Best sellers, inventory insights, category performance
  • Marketing Automation – AI-powered email, SMS, and WhatsApp campaigns
  • Cart Recovery – Automated abandoned cart detection and recovery
  • AI Insights – AI-powered business intelligence and recommendations

Third-Party Services

This plugin connects to the Fidras Server, an external service that you self-host or use as a managed service. The server URL is configured by the store administrator in the plugin settings.

When connected, this plugin sends the following data to your configured Fidras server:

  • Customer data – Names, email addresses, and order history via WooCommerce webhooks
  • Order data – Order details, products purchased, and transaction information via WooCommerce webhooks
  • Product data – Product catalog information via the WooCommerce REST API
  • Cart data – Cart contents and session information for abandoned cart detection

This data is transmitted securely over HTTPS. No data is sent to any third-party service until you explicitly configure and connect to a Fidras server.

  • Fidras website: https://catalystiq.ae
  • Privacy Policy: https://catalystiq.ae/privacy
  • Terms of Service: https://catalystiq.ae/terms-of-service

Privacy Policy

This plugin stores connection settings (server URL, authentication token, webhook secret) in your WordPress database. Customer, order, and product data is transmitted to your configured Fidras analytics server for processing. For details on how the Fidras server handles your data, please see the Fidras Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the fidras-by-catalystiq folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu
  3. Go to Fidras by CatalystIQ > Settings and enter your Fidras server URL
  4. Click “Connect to Fidras” to complete setup
sections.faq:
Do I need a Fidras server?

Yes, this plugin connects to a self-hosted Fidras analytics server. The server handles all data processing and dashboard rendering.

What data does this plugin share?

The plugin shares WooCommerce customer, order, and product data with your Fidras server via WooCommerce webhooks and REST API. See the “Third-Party Services” section above for full details.

Is my data secure?

All data is transmitted over HTTPS and encrypted. No data is shared with any service other than the Fidras server you configure.
